test_cases.title: A customer search by a known QAL number lists that customer
acs: DERIVED: Manage Contracts > Search finds each of 40 existing customers by QAL number (data/seed/samples.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
QAL numbers were sampled at random from tblCustomer; a result may list more than one customer.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 40 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx, click Manage Contracts then Search.
Type the QAL number of the row in the QAL Number box.
steps.expected: The box shows the QAL number.
The page reloads with the h1 Search.
A row for the QAL number is listed.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.

Representative sample: one row stands for the 38 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.
